Sun Cafe is one long hall built around one long window. We pour coffee, keep 67 chairs comfortable, and let the light rearrange the room a little every hour.
A big room with nowhere to hide from the sun.
A short menu, written by the clock.
Half in the sun, half in the shade.
Four steps, none of them rushed.
